cohort: 487 inborn preterm infants born at <28 weeks of gestation and <1,000 g, admitted to a tertiary NICU in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, between 2017 and 2024.
finding: Metabolic bone disease (MBD) was diagnosed in 41.5% of extremely preterm infants and was associated with growth failure, prolonged hospitalization, and an increased risk of fractures, with a 4-week PTH screen showing good discrimination for radiologic osteopenia.
